models_evaluated: multivariable logistic regression postpartum hemorrhage model (21 risk factors)
CMQCC postpartum hemorrhage risk assessment tool

links.outcome: Model discrimination on prospective real-time automated EHR data versus retrospective validation
links.effect: Derivation AUC 0.81; temporal validation AUC 0.80; prospective real-time automated data (928 patients) AUC 0.82 (95% CI 0.73-0.91), so no performance degradation.
links.quote: The model maintained performance in prospective, automated data collected with the predictive model in real time (AUC 0.82 [95% CI, 0.73-0.91]).

screen.reason: The study validates a predictive model programmed into the EHR using prospectively collected real-time EHR data (silent-mode real deployment), but only evaluates model predictive performance rather than testing an organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
